segments.name: Seabed Mineral Exploration
segments.description: Discovers, validates and develops high-value seafloor mineral resources and provides specialized mineral exploration, project development and marine services to clients.
segments.evidence: We provide specialized mineral exploration, project development and marine services to clients (subsidiary companies, other companies and/or governments).

revenueModel.text: Clients, including subsidiary companies, other companies and governments, pay for specialized mineral exploration, project development and marine services, and Odyssey may elect to receive equity for services on select mineral projects.
revenueModel.evidence: As our business is focused on the development of a diversified portfolio of subsea resources, we may elect to receive equity for the provision of our services on select mineral projects.
